answer: Each submission hangs on the sable of a task receipt, and the lagoon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
